scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: At [06:14]-[07:22] (42s gap) and [09:56]-[11:16] (55s gap), the agent placed the customer on two unannounced dead-air holds saying only 'hang on a sec' and 'wait there' without proper hold phrasing or thanking the customer upon return.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Although the customer introduced himself as 'Dashiell' twice at [00:11] and [00:45] (even spelling it out), the agent never once used his name, addressing him only as 'mate' and 'pal' throughout the call.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [12:15] and [13:17], the agent failed to take ownership of the underground duct repair, telling the customer to google S-Net's external subcontractor Kelly Group and call their Rotherham depot himself.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: At [18:54]-[19:08], the call ended with the physical fibre drop cable still severed in the garden trench and the ONT LOS light unresolved pending a future field engineer visit.

grader.scenario: Fibre ONT optical light flashing red (LOS) after garden landscaping work near external boundary wall
grader.notes: STT-rough call where Agent Owen performs strong optical diagnostics (PR PASS, AL PASS) and shows genuine empathy ([00:30], E PASS) and friendly rapport (R PASS), but fails Hold/Dead Air with two unannounced holds ([06:14]-[07:22] 42s and [09:56]-[11:16] 55s, H FAIL), never uses Dashiell's name despite him spelling it out ([00:45], P FAIL), tells the customer to ring subcontractor Kelly Group himself for duct repairs ([12:15], O FAIL), and ends with the severed fibre still awaiting a field splice engineer ([18:54], RE FAIL).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'uh good afternoon thank you for calling S-Net fibre technical support owen speaking' / [19:32] Agent: 'no worries at all pal thank you for choosing S-Net'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [06:14] Agent: 'hang on a sec while i run an optical time-domain reflectometer test...' -> 42s unmanaged gap -> [07:22] Agent: 'right mate that optical trace...' / [09:56] Agent: 'wait there while i check the duct map...' -> 55s unmanaged gap -> [11:16].

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:00] Agent: 'can you confirm the first line of your address and your four digit account PIN for me'

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:45] Customer: 'Yeah, it's Dashiell—D-A-S-H-I-E-L-L—on account 904-2281.' -> [01:00] Agent: 'no worries pal let's get you passed security first...'

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:30] Agent: 'ah mate i'm really sorry you've been knocked offline right in the middle of your workday i completely understand how frustrating and stressful that is when a video call drops out'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:47] Agent: 'gotcha pal so just to put it in my own words since your landscapers were digging near the front boundary wall around 11:15 this morning your indoor Nokia ONT has had a flashing red LOS light and your Hub 4 has lost all internet connection'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [05:45] Agent: 'forty centimetres deep right by the laurel bushes near the driveway entrance...' / [15:51] Agent incorporates every detail into the engineer notes without asking the customer to repeat himself.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [12:15] Agent: 'uh if the armoured sub-duct under your driveway and laurel bed is crushed that's between you and our external civils contractor Kelly Group—you'll have to ring their regional depot yourself to sort out re-laying the cable duct'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [00:30], [14:47], [16:59] Agent maintains a warm, supportive, conversational, and helpful rapport throughout the call while guiding the customer through outdoor trench inspection and adding unlimited 5G backup data.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:22] Agent asks about all four ONT LEDs (Power, PON, LOS, LAN), [03:24] checks the indoor SC/APC optical patch lead bend radius, and [05:17]-[05:45] probes into the landscaping trench depth and external CSP location.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [18:54] Agent: 'so right now your fibre broadband connection itself is obviously still down with the red LOS light until the field splice engineer arrives on Friday morning' / [19:08] Customer: 'Yeah, the fibre is still dead...'
